title: 第十一章 必须要变的更强才行！
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
“成功了………”
迪卡凯恩望着眼前的这把剑，眼中透露出了复杂的感情，他侧过身体，望着身边那个浑身上下包裹在斗篷之中的陌生人。
“来吧，拿起你的长剑，我知道你的身份………陌生人，现在，是你回想起这一切的时候了。”
“我能够感觉到………这把剑在呼唤我………”
陌生人缓缓自语着，伸出手去拿过那把长剑，随后，他的眼中猛然闪过了一丝光亮！
“我想起来了…………一切！我叫泰瑞尔，曾是一名天使………”
“是的，泰瑞尔。”
听到泰瑞尔的说话，迪卡凯恩高兴的点了点头。
“你终于回想起了你的身份，我们有了更多可以对抗邪恶的力量………还有你，小伙子。”
一面说着，迪卡凯恩一面望向了站在旁边的方正。
“多亏了你，我们才能够及时寻回第三块残片，不仅如此，你甚至还消灭了玛格妲这个邪恶的走狗………”
“不用客气，我只是做了我应该做的事情。”
听到迪卡凯恩的感谢，方正勉强露出了一丝苦笑。虽然现在他寻回了残片，而且迪卡凯恩也顺利恢复了圣剑，并且没有因此死去，自己的第三个任务也完成了。可是，看着自己系统之中只剩下了三次的【阿尔萨斯】灵魂石使用次数，方正却怎么都高兴不起来。
自己还是太弱了！！
在方正的考虑之中，灵魂石的激活模式一直都是自己最后的底牌，他原本是打算在面对墨菲斯托，巴尔之类的魔神，又或者主世界那些强大的传奇存在时才会使用。但让方正没有想到的是，自己居然会逼到在面对玛格妲时就激活了一次灵魂石！
玛格妲算个屁啊，一个第二幕第一关的小BOSS，居然逼的自己开大招！！
这简直就是杀鸡用牛刀！
而更让方正郁闷的是，如果不用牛刀，自己根本杀不死这只鸡！
他还是太弱了！
这一刻，方正深深的感觉到了自己的无力。如果是在自己原本那个普通的世界里，那么他依靠自己的本领，还能够有所作为。可是在这里，在主世界，那些拥有超凡力量的人，可以随随便便的就威胁到自己的生命。

必须要变的更强才行！
方正暗暗下定了决心，如果不变强的话，那么他每次遇到敌人，难道都要靠开大招来混日子吗？
大招能开几次？！
等灵魂石消耗完之后，他难道就只能躺在地上等死？
唯一让方正感到些许安慰的就是，在干掉玛格妲之后，自己的两个任务【霜之哀伤的诅咒】与【守护者】也是彻底完成了。
其中【霜之哀伤的诅咒】是方正在变身巫妖王，大肆屠杀了玛格妲以及邪教徒之后完成的。而且通过吸收的灵魂数量来看是超额完成。但不知道是不是霜之哀伤认为方正整天拿着自己呼唤圣光太掉份儿，最终方正即便是超额完成任务，也只是获得了双倍奖励———好吧，其实说白了就是霜之哀伤把方正的【十字军打击】技能熟练度从C提升到A，然后拍拍屁股就走人了。
而熟练度提升到A的【十字军打击】也转化为了一门名叫【皇家十字剑术】的常驻剑术技能。方正当然也从中得到了关于这门剑术的知识，这门剑术有点儿类似于山口山和暗黑的双技能合体。它大部分剑术效果都保持着山口山的圣骑特性，但是在群体AOE方面却更贴近暗黑………
好吧，方正现在想吐槽的就是，阿尔萨斯你练的果然是皇家限量典藏版吗？
相对于小气到不行的霜之哀伤来说，【守护者】这个任务的奖励送给方正的好处就更多，除了方正的次元点数又增加了3点之外，他的随机奖励则是获得一个名叫【神圣守护者】的头衔。
【神圣守护者：你扭转了本无法避免的命运，驱散了那蒙尘在未来的迷雾，虽然我们仍未能够知道那尽头的等待着我们的究竟是什么，但是你所做的努力值得传颂（佩戴头衔时，所有善良阵营人物对你初始声望为友善，你对邪恶阵营伤害提升100%，邪恶阵营对你的伤害降低30%）】
正是因为这个头衔，所以方正才算是松了口气。

content_en:
"Success..."
Deckard Kane looked at the sword in front of him, with complicated emotions revealed in his eyes. He turned sideways and looked at the stranger next to him, who was wrapped in a cloak.
"Come on, pick up your sword, I know your identity... Stranger, now is the time for you to recall all this."
"I can feel...this sword calling me..."
The stranger muttered slowly to himself, stretched out his hand to take the long sword, and then, a light suddenly flashed in his eyes!
"I remembered...everything! My name is Tyrael, I was an angel..."
"Yes, Tyrell."
Hearing Tyrell's words, Deckard Cain nodded happily.
"You finally remember who you are, and we have more power to fight evil... and you, young man."
As he spoke, Deckard Kane looked at Fang Zheng standing next to him.
"Thanks to you, we were able to recover the third fragment in time. Not only that, you even eliminated Magda, the evil lackey..."
"You're welcome, I just did what I was supposed to do."
Hearing Deckard Cain's thanks, Fang Zheng reluctantly showed a wry smile. Although now he has recovered the fragments, and Deckard Cain has successfully restored the Holy Sword, and did not die because of it, his third mission has been completed. However, Fang Zheng couldn't be happier seeing that he only had three uses of the [Alsace] Soul Stone left in his system.
I am still too weak! !
In Fang Zheng's consideration, the activation mode of the soul stone has always been his last trump card. He originally planned to use it when facing demon gods such as Mephisto and Baal, or those powerful legendary beings in the main world. But what Fang Zheng didn't expect was that he would actually be forced to activate the soul stone once when facing Magda!
Magda is nothing, a small BOSS in the first level of the second act actually forced herself to use her ultimate move! !
This is simply killing a chicken with a knife!
What makes Fang Zheng even more depressed is that he can't kill this chicken without using a knife!
He is still too weak!
At this moment, Fang Zheng deeply felt his own powerlessness. If it were in his original ordinary world, then he could still make a difference relying on his own abilities. But here, in the main world, those with extraordinary power can threaten their own lives at will.
You have to become stronger!
Fang Zheng secretly made up his mind. If he didn't become stronger, would he have to use his ultimate move to get by every time he encountered an enemy?
How many times can the ultimate move be used? !
After the soul stone is consumed, can he just lie on the ground and wait for death?
The only thing that gave Fang Zheng some comfort was that after killing Magda, his two tasks [Curse of Frostmourne] and [Guardian] were also completely completed.
Among them, [Curse of Frostmourne] was completed after Fang Zheng transformed into the Lich King and massacred Magda and the cultists. And judging from the number of souls absorbed, it was overachieved. But I don’t know if Frostmourne thought it was too shameful for Fang Zheng to summon the Holy Light all day long. In the end, even though Fang Zheng overcompleted the task, he only received a double reward. Well, to put it bluntly, Frostmourne raised Fang Zheng’s [Crusader Strike] skill proficiency from C to A, then patted his butt and left.
The [Crusader Strike] with proficiency level raised to A has also been transformed into a permanent swordsmanship skill called [Royal Cross Swordsmanship]. Of course, Fang Zheng also gained knowledge about this swordsmanship. This swordsmanship is somewhat similar to the combination of Yamaguchiyama and Diablo's dual skills. Most of its swordsmanship effects maintain Yamaguchiyama's Paladin characteristics, but in terms of group AOE, it is closer to Dark Knight.black......
Okay, what Fang Zheng wants to complain about now is, Alsace, is it really the Royal Limited Collection Edition that you are practicing?
Compared to Frostmourne, who is extremely stingy, the reward for the [Guardian] mission given to Fang Zheng has more benefits. In addition to Fang Zheng's dimension points increasing by 3 points, his random reward is to obtain a title called [Holy Guardian].
[Holy Guardian: You have reversed the inevitable fate and dispelled the fog that has covered the future. Although we still cannot know what is waiting for us at the end, your efforts are worthy of praise (when wearing the title, all good camp characters will have an initial reputation of being friendly to you, your damage to the evil camp will be increased by 100%, and the damage to you from the evil camp will be reduced by 30%)]
It was precisely because of this title that Fang Zheng was relieved.
